mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact dimensionless fixed-EOS subcritical-core base, scalar matching derivative, radial coercivity constants, EOS gate normalization; bounded non-interval shooting illustration of the positive-neutral/NLED branch.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact SymPy identities plus IEEE double precision SciPy DOP853/Brent quadratures; no interval ODE claim.
mathematics.conventions: Newtonian rest-mass gravity; charged Gamma2 core and neutral n5 atmosphere; both conserved currents varied in total rest-mass frame; subcritical charge alpha=b_q² in (0,1).

bounds.shooting_samples: alpha=1/2 delta=1e-6 eta=1e-3; outer radii100,200,400; start1e-6; DOP853 rtol2e-11 atol2e-13.
bounds.sample_interpretation: Finite floating samples are not certificates of the qualitative existence neighborhood; the analytic proof supplies sufficiently-small existence.
bounds.resources: 45 seconds wall cap, 35 CPU seconds, one numerical-library thread.

non_claims: No interval ODE sample certification or explicit universal threshold.
Subcritical charge and EOS normalization are chosen continuum inputs; original critical galaxy law is not retained automatically.
